items.title: Should You Buy Coinbase Stock While Its Revenue Is Shrinking?
items.summary: Coinbase Global (COIN) stock has gained about 18% over the past month, and it is still down about 44% over the past year. At about $175 a share, the market pays 7.3 times sales against 3.2 for the S&P 500, more than double the market's price for revenue that is shrinking. The question is whether what Coinbase is building is worth more than what it is losing.
